# sing-box installer adapter

`sing-box.sh` is based on [fscarmen/sing-box v1.3.31](https://github.com/fscarmen/sing-box/tree/2dd34b2d5a9c14b85d4a0a737267d05353eb1948) and is distributed under the accompanying GPL-3.0 license. The optional dashboard manager uses the local adapter to install a verified core, report progress and regenerate subscriptions. The existing monitoring deployment continues to use its own scripts.
